'''Denth ''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] employee of [[Galactic Solutions Industries]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Invasion of Ziost]] in [[3636 BBY]]<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|3.2}}</ref> he was present at the GSI orbital station above the planet, from which he witnessed the devastation of [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]].<ref name="SWTOR" />
